route_matrix.rule: Every (method, template) of the controllers has exactly one row: public_routes, session_routes, business_routes or one basis group of denied. The pure test fails on a controller route without a row, a row without a controller route, a row in two places, and counts that disagree with the controllers or invariants_live ROUTES. Nothing is denied by subtraction.

basis_legend.report: reading/report workflow: writes the report, drafts, hold, dictation or study state, or reads drafts, history, citations, structure, the worklist/bootstrap payload or a body at every RS. The clinician reads are GET clinician/studies and GET clinician/studies/:uid/report (S5-U1b).
basis_legend.viewer: viewer annotations, findings, manual SR and viewer jobs: writes, or reads revisions, hidden rows and authors. The clinician's final-only item read is GET studies/:uid/viewer-items (S5-U1b).
basis_legend.operations: technologist and reader operations: tech notes, reader assignment and candidates, Preliminary colleagues, order match/unmatch.
basis_legend.workspace: the caller's reading-workspace state, personal or site-shared (prefs, filters, favorites, templates, columns, layout, shortcuts, appearance, reading preferences, hanging protocols, study tags) and the caller's own StudyAccess status. No clinician screen uses them before S5-U2a.
basis_legend.admin: member console, study-access administration, audit, unassigned studies and institution assignment (need admin).
basis_legend.consultation: consultations and consultation candidates; the clinician question contract is S5-U4p/U4a, denied until then.
basis_legend.connect: inter-institution Connect agreements, basis and transfers; a far later stage (AGENTS).
basis_legend.gateway: the gateway client-credentials surface (needExact gateway) and the technician's Now Retry request (S4-U3/U4); never a clinician action.

GET clinician/studies.basis: narrow clinician worklist read: listStudies scope, one-snapshot report status, no drafts, bodies or writer fields; declared in allowed_additions

GET clinician/studies/:uid/report.basis: the final head's body and key images only at RS A with an approve/addendum head, status otherwise; declared in allowed_additions

POST studies/:uid/dictation.basis: report writer path: dictationGate runs the report-draft write refusals and every attempt is audited; a clinician writes no report text

GET gateway/retry-requests.basis: gateway client-credentials pull of pending Now Retry UIDs (needExact gateway)

POST studies/:uid/gateway-retry.basis: technician Now Retry request (need technician, owning institution only)

controller_decorators.rule: S5-U1c D6: every @Name( in a controller is either an HTTP route decorator the inventory reads or one of these; any other name (a WebDAV route decorator of a later Nest, @RequestMapping, @Version, a custom route wrapper) fails the pure test until it is classified here or read by the inventory

outside_decorators.rule: S5-U1c-F03: every api/src .ts file that is not *.controller.ts is read by the controllers' lexer and decorator runs inside the inventory, so test_05 fails on it. A route decorator, @Controller(), @RequestMapping() or @Public() there is refused (both inventories open *.controller.ts only), as is a shape the runs cannot read, such call text in a comment or literal, and any decorator name not listed here (an alias or a wrapper could declare a route) until it is classified here.

decorator_bindings.rule: S5-U1c-F04: the inventories classify a decorator by its name, so every name a decorator run carries, in a controller or any other api/src file, must be bound once by 'import { Name } from' the module listed here (a relative module is named from api/src and resolved from the importing file) and occur nowhere else in the code but its decorators and after a '.'. No import or export renames a listed name, a route name, Controller, RequestMapping or Public, from or to another name; no namespace, default, import = or export * takes '@nestjs/common', a part of it or './auth.guard', or binds such a name; no identifier is escaped in code; a statement the reader does not know is refused. The Public binding ends at public_declaration, the one place auth.guard.ts names Public, whose SetMetadata is public_metadata_import. A new decorator module or spelling is a new decision: list it here. S5-U1c-F05: the runs alone named what was checked, so an imported route name or Public applied by a plain call ('Put('x')(target, key, descriptor)') made a public route both inventories missed. In every api/src file a route name, Controller, RequestMapping, Public or SetMetadata occurs in code only as the local name of its own-name import (from the module above; RequestMapping and SetMetadata from '@nestjs/common') and as a decorator the runs read; a call, a reference handed on (variable, array, object, applyDecorators, Reflect.decorate), a property ('x.Get'), a declaration or an export is refused, and Public's module keeps Public and SetMetadata to public_declaration. No metadata writer occurs (defineMetadata, decorate, createDecorator; Reflect only as 'Reflect.<member>' of a member source_contract lists), and loaders follow source_contract (S5-U1c-F06).

source_contract.rule: S5-U1c-F06: the closed contract of the lexer and loader checks. module_loads read a loader call by its first string or token and let member calls and calls that ':' followed pass, so require('@nest' + 'js/common'), module.require(name), 'true ? require(name) : null' and module['require']('@nestjs/common') loaded Nest's common unread and common['Put'] made a public route both inventories missed. Every api/src .ts file is read in the supported forms below and every other form that reaches a loader, an evaluator, a metadata writer or a class prototype is refused (fail-closed); a new form, package, Reflect or process member is a new decision, listed here only after checking that it neither loads nor evaluates code nor writes route or public metadata. refused pins each refusal regression with the reasons it must be refused for (fragments in order inside one check's message); accepted pins the controls that must still read; f06_loaders pins the reviewer's four loaders.
supported: a decorator '@Name(...)' applied directly, Name bound once by its own-name import from decorator_bindings.modules (S5-U1c-F01-F05)

an ES module statement naming a plain string module: a file under api/src or a package in packages; a decorator name only by its own-name named import; no namespace, default, import = or export * of a project file or a '@nestjs/' package; import 'm' counts as naming m

require('<package>') and import('<package>'): the bare callee and exactly one plain '...' or "..." literal without an escape between the parentheses, naming a package in loaded_packages; import x = require('<package>') is such a call
a method named require: declared in a class body ('[modifier] require(...) {' or ': T {') and called only as this.require(...) or this.<field>.require(...)

a string literal, or a template without substitutions, alone between '[' and ']' is read as the name it spells: x['require'] is x.require, x?.['require'] is x?.require and common['Put'] is common.Put for every name check; such a key with an escape is refused

a string literal or template without substitutions whose value (escapes decoded) is one of sealed_words or sealed_strings stands only as an element of an array literal: elsewhere a reflective call (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(X, 'prototype')), a quoted key ({ '__proto__': p }) or a quoted member name ('constructor'() { ... }) reads it as that name

Object and Array only as <Name>.<member>, <Name><type arguments> or new <Name>(...), and never after a declaring keyword; process only as process.<process_members>; Reflect only as Reflect.<reflect_members>; prototype only as <prototype_owners>.prototype; getPrototypeOf only as Object.getPrototypeOf(...) compared by === or !==; constructor only as a declaration whose body holds no return; no class heading in a *.controller.ts file has extends
outside_the_contract: a property reached by a key computed at run time or found by enumeration: x[key], x['a' + 'b'], x[('a')], Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(X, key), Reflect.ownKeys(X) or Object.values(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(X)) and an index into the result. A lexical check does not follow values, and any value reaches Function through its constructor chain this way. Every named and literal spelling of those handles is refused, so what is left is key text computed on purpose; comparing the routes the running app registered with route_matrix in the live module would close it, and that is not part of this unit

request handlers that are not controller routes: middleware and HTTP-adapter handlers (main.ts app.use, AppModule.configure consumer.apply) and path rewriting (setGlobalPrefix, RouterModule, versioning). The inventories read controller routes and the clinician gate is a guard on them; neither reads these

request_method_pin.rule: S5-U1c D6: request_method_enum is the Python model's table (0-8). A member it does not know answers None (denied) in the model, while the product's RequestMethod reverse map names it; both deny, because every allowlist key's method is GET or POST. The full member list of the locked version was not read in this unit (no installed copy). When lock_version changes, re-read enums/request-method.enum.d.ts of the new version and update request_method_enum and this pin together.

role_composition.rule: RISK-S5-U1c-MIXED-DOWNGRADE: only clinicianOnly() narrows, and only where listed. A token with any legacy role never meets the clinician gate or a clinician projection; a clinician-only token never passes a denied row. A new narrowing site is a new decision and must be listed here.

live_matrix.study: one run-owned synthetic hallym study (LiveStack.create_fixture, C-STORE), report left at RS W; the matrix writes no report, item or setting

identities.clinician: clinician-only member of hallym, the study's institution
identities.gateway: valid gateway client-credentials identity of kin-center (LiveStack.service_token)
identities.cinvalid: clinician-only member with two institution groups, created by the case

wrong_tenant.basis: a session row names no study; its tenant axis is the membership check (exactly one institution group)
by design, not a leak: the pending/invalid logout exception (auth.guard.ts isLogout) ends only the caller's own session and answers no data

GET authz/dicom.via: nginx auth_request of GET /dicom-web/studies/{uid}/metadata, its only caller; nginx answers the refusal with a status only

wrong_tenant.basis: a collection: the other institution's clinician is answered, without the study

read_contract.rule: S5-F5 conservative default: body, key images and viewer items only when rs=A and the head ReportVersion (uid, Report.version) action is approve or addendum; D-S5-NONFINAL-VIEW stays open
